title: Data Subscription Agreement for AWS Marketplace
version_or_date: 2022-07-14 (date in the published file name; the document text itself is undated)

parties.licensor: Provider (the data provider that lists the Data under a DSA Offer on AWS Marketplace)
parties.licensee: Subscriber, extended to its Affiliates and their Users, including contractors

permitted_use.value: Provider licenses Subscriber, its Affiliates and their Users (incl. contractors) to receive, retain, use and modify the Data and create Derived Data, subject to the DSA Offer; all other rights reserved; Third Party Data may carry narrower rights.

ai_training_rights.value: Not named: no clause on training, fine-tuning, evaluation or model outputs; building models is permitted only implicitly as Derived Data ('models', 'algorithms'), owned by Subscriber; redistributing the Data itself is barred; any AI limits must come from the DSA Offer.

field_of_use.value: No field-of-use limit in the DSA beyond its listed restrictions (no service-bureau use); each DSA Offer or Third Party Terms may add restrictions.

territory.value: Worldwide, subject to US export-control and embargo restrictions.

term_duration.value: Runs until the Subscription concludes; Subscriber may cancel any time (refund per Offer); either party for uncured material breach (30 days); Provider may suspend/terminate without refund for law, non-cooperation with investigation, or security incidents.

exclusivity.value: Nonexclusive licence; the DSA offers no exclusivity.

sublicensing.value: No sale, sublicence, lending or third-party access; use only by Subscriber's Affiliates and Users, for whom Subscriber is liable; licence nontransferable, agreement assignable without consent only to Affiliates or an acquirer.

derivatives_and_model_outputs.value: Subscriber owns Derived Data (analytics, tools, models, algorithms) except any Data embedded in it; Derived Data excludes unmodified Data; Provider gets no rights in it; distributing a material subset of the Data inside it is still barred.

attribution.value: No attribution duty; Subscriber must keep Provider's and its licensors' trademark and copyright notices intact; no publicity naming the other party without consent.

audit_rights.value: No audit right; Provider may suspend/terminate without refund if Subscriber does not cooperate with a reasonable breach investigation, and Subscriber must report unauthorised use or disclosure.

deletion_on_termination.value: On termination/expiry use rights end; within 90 days Subscriber removes the Data from its AWS account and other systems, and destroys other copies only if Provider instructs; Derived Data is not named in the deletion duty; confidentiality survives.

warranties_by_provider.value: Provider warrants any personal data is already lawfully public and not sensitive, malware scanning, and no copyleft-type terms; remedy is correction, then termination with prorated refund in 30 days; no warranty of accuracy, completeness or fitness.

consent_and_release_warranty.value: Provider bears consent risk: warrants any identifying data is already lawfully public and contains no sensitive data (incl. biometric, precise geolocation), and indemnifies for missing consents/rights and privacy or publicity claims; no release documents go to the buyer.

indemnity.value: One-way: Provider indemnifies Subscriber and Affiliates for personal-data warranty breaches, missing rights/consents, IP/publicity/privacy infringement, unlawful Data and missing disclosures; uncapped; excludes Subscriber modifications or misuse; backed by USD 5M insurance.

liability_cap.value: Mutual cap at the greater of 3x Subscriber Spend (trailing 12 months) or USD 1M; no indirect/consequential damages; uncapped for indemnity, confidentiality breach, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, violation of law; breach-notice costs deemed direct; AWS bears no liability.

payment_and_revenue_share.value: Fees, rates and refund policy are set in each DSA Offer; the DSA fixes refunds only for warranty failure (prorated) and infringement; no revenue share or AWS fee is stated.

takedown_and_erasure.value: No takedown or data-subject erasure mechanism; for infringing Data Provider modifies/replaces it or either party terminates with refund; Provider may suspend if law requires; buyer deletes only on termination (90 days), otherwise keeps downloaded copies.

governing_law.value: New York law; exclusive forum in state and federal courts in Manhattan; CISG excluded.

change_of_terms.value: No unilateral changes: amendments only in a writing signed by both parties; precedence amendment > DSA > DSA Offer; Subscriber's AWS Customer Agreement and Service Terms prevail over all.

prohibited_uses.value: No redistribution or third-party access, sale or sublicence, reverse engineering, consultant/service-bureau use, re-identification of de-identified data, or export to embargoed countries.

unknowns.note: No express grant or exclusion of ML training, fine-tuning, evaluation, or rights in model outputs; only the Derived Data definition (which lists 'models') covers it.
No mechanism for a data subject's erasure request or for recalling specific items from a live subscription; nothing obliges the Subscriber to delete superseded or replaced revisions.

No model- or property-release warranty as such, and no delivery of consent or release evidence to the Subscriber; consent is handled through the Section 4.1 public-data warranty and the Section 7.1 indemnity.
Section 10.8 refers to 'Provider Indemnified Parties' but Section 7 contains no Subscriber indemnity.
AWS's own listing or transaction fee and payout mechanics are not in the DSA (AWS is not a party); they sit in AWS's seller terms.
The deletion duty names only 'the Data'; the DSA does not say whether models or other Derived Data built during the subscription may be kept, only that Subscriber owns them.
